title: China's first emperor to Kevin Hart in five links?
description: An opera, a theatre opening, a summit and a TV taping connect Qin Shi Huang to Kevin Hart.
hook: How is Qin Shi Huang connected to Kevin Hart?

links.line: In 2006, New York's Met staged an opera about Qin Shi Huang, with Plácido Domingo playing the emperor.
In 2013, Domingo shared champagne with Vladimir Putin at the opening of the Mariinsky Theatre's new stage.
In 2015, Putin met Barack Obama at the United Nations in New York to talk about Syria.

image.file: File:Defense Secretary Ash Carter awards the Honorable Barack H. Obama, 44th President of the United States, with the Department of Defense Medal for Distinguished Public Service.jpg

links.line: In January 2017, Obama's defense secretary Ash Carter gave him the Pentagon's medal for distinguished public service.
And in 2016, Carter met Kevin Hart backstage at a Late Night with Seth Meyers taping in Washington.
